identity.name: FINCABLES
identity.industry: Wires & Cables / Optical Fibre & Power Cables (electrical infra + telecom transmission)

summary.oneLiner: Steady electrical-cable cash cow funding an optionality call on optical-fibre: preform backward-integration just commissioned + fibre draw capacity doubling to 8M km into a globally tight fibre market (data-center + defence pull), with the long-loss-making EHV/Sumitomo JV finally turning profitable.

one-line thesis: Steady electrical-cable cash cow funding an optionality call on optical-fibre: preform backward-integration just commissioned + fibre draw capacity doubling to 8M km into a globally tight fibre market (data-center + defence pull), with the long-loss-making EHV/Sumitomo JV finally turning profitable.
financial scorecard: One-offs: ~INR 300 cr inventory build (pre-buying RM coverage post-Mideast shock); CFO ~INR 50 cr lower YoY due to inventory; 14 price hikes in FY26 (~24-25% effective on electrical SKUs) + 1 more in FY27.
guidance (next quarter / verify): Mgmt explicitly declines formal guidance given war/supply-chain volatility.
Comm EBIT margin: did ~6% FY26; "should do better"; targets 8-9% by FY27 IF no supply-chain constraints (75% util scenario).
Fibre price benefit to financials only from ~Q2FY27 (fixed long-term domestic contract runs to end-June; renegotiation expected).
Preform benefit kicks in end-Q2 / Q3 FY27 (3-4 month stabilization from Mar-26 commissioning).
H2 FY27 should be "much better than last year" on Comm side, supply-chain permitting.
Opex/employee cost % of sales: similar to FY26 on annual basis.
order book & pipeline: OFC: one major contract (>half of capacity), 8-yr relationship, up for renewal end-June FY27 — high confidence of renewal; balance sold to other customers. Specific OFC order-book number not disclosed.
EHV JV: opened FY26 with ~INR 380 cr order book; key machinery >80% utilized; capacity expansion planned to lift overall plant util to 70-75%.
EHV addressable market: $0.5-0.75bn today → could reach $4-5bn in 3-4 years (utility-led).
segment / subsidiary detail: Electrical (record INR 1,697 cr Q4): Auto batteries +30% vol, industrial flexibles +17%, power +21% (all high-double-digit). Building/housing wire only marginal vol growth (copper price pass-through caused retail/dealer destocking; project sales stable). Agri apps down ~15-16% (monsoon). Retail:project mix shifted from ~80:20 to ~two-thirds:one-third. Util ~mid-60s (66%); ~15% headroom; max ~80-85%.
Communication: ~75% of segment is optical-fibre. Draw capacity 4M km, utilization ~3.2/4M (~80%). Comm rev flat FY26 (~INR 500 cr) but Q4 +30%; volume +7%.
FMEG: Underperforming ("under par"). Fans flat (BIS norm change → destocking + unseasonal rain). PVC conduits strong, ~85% util. Portfolio/team/distribution under review.
EHV JV (Sumitomo): Turned profitable FY26 — first time after years of losses; blend of pure-supply (faster cash) + turnkey orders; higher voltage grades focus.
growth verticals / optionality: Optical-fibre preform (just commissioned, 100 MT Phase 1): backward integration → flexibility to sell preform OR convert to fibre/cable depending on market; expected ~5-10% cost advantage vs market once stabilized.
Fibre draw capacity doubling 4M → 8M km (complete Jul/Aug FY27); post-expansion total OFC revenue potential ~INR 750 cr.
Solar DC cable: introduced Q4FY25, near full capacity, capacity being doubled (part of new capex).
Data-center fibre (India localization push + AI) = multi-year structural demand.
Exports: revamped team; INR 30 cr (FY25) → INR 52 cr (FY26); revenue share <1% → targeting 2-3% over 2 yrs.
margins & cost dynamics: Late-Q4 margin squeeze: Mideast shock → RM cost hikes across the board + INR depreciation + inventory cost creep; copper LME briefly low but offset by other RM.
Opex & employee cost % of sales at 12-quarter lows; mgmt says annual level holds.
Comm margin improvement (Q4 ~6% EBIT) driven by a few non-contract orders at current (high) fibre prices + scale; fixed domestic contract caps near-term upside.
Germanium (for preform) is the key cost/supply chokepoint — few months' inventory.
capex / expansion: FY26 spend: ~INR 240 cr (incl. Sumitomo JV infusion).
FY27 plan: ~INR 300 cr total = INR 200 cr new capacity enhancement (incl. doubling solar line) + INR 100 cr balance on OFC preform/8M-km fibre expansion.
No plans to go further backward into silica production.
capital allocation: Self-funded organic capex (~INR 300 cr); continued infusion/support to EHV JV now yielding returns. Inventory build (~INR 300 cr) is defensive working-capital, expected to unwind as costs pass through. No buyback/dividend/M&A commentary.
risks & watch-items: Geopolitical (Mideast/Russia wars) → RM supply-chain disruption, fibre/germanium availability, INR depreciation.
Germanium & imported glass/preform-input export restrictions (China/Europe) — defence-use covenants limit participation in lucrative military fibre demand.
Copper price volatility suppressing retail housing-wire demand.
Fixed-price domestic OFC contract delays realization of high spot fibre prices to Q2FY27.
management quality / tone: New Deputy CEO/CFO Mahesh Viswanathan — candid, conservative, explicitly refuses to give guidance numbers in a volatile environment ("won't stick my neck out"). Detailed, numbers-grounded answers; honest about FMEG weakness and supply-chain constraints. Credible.
non-obvious takeaways: Defence fibre demand is real but largely inaccessible to Finolex due to RM-supplier covenants — so the upside narrative is data-center, not defence.
Preform = an option, not just cost-save: lets the company arbitrage between selling preform (when cable orders thin) vs converting to high-margin fibre (when fibre prices spike, as now).
EHV JV inflection (first profit + 5x market expansion potential) is an under-discussed multi-year driver tied to grid capex.
Comm revenue looks flat YoY but masks a sharp H2 price-led recovery whose P&L benefit is contractually deferred to FY27 — a setup for an FY27 step-up.
Housing-wire weakness is a copper-price/destocking phenomenon, not end-demand collapse (project sales stable).
qoq change log: This quarter (Q4/FY26):
Revenue +22% YoY/QoQ; electrical record INR 1,697 cr; Comm Q4 +30%.
Preform plant commissioned (Mar-26, 100 MT Phase 1) — major backward-integration milestone.
EHV/Sumitomo JV turned profitable first time (PBT ~INR 21 cr on ~INR 450 cr).
~INR 300 cr defensive inventory build post-Mideast shock; late-Q4 margin pressure.
Solar DC cable near full capacity; doubling announced.
Next-quarter watch items (Q1-Q2 FY27):
OFC fibre draw capacity 4M → 8M km completion (Jul/Aug); revenue potential ~INR 750 cr.
Major OFC contract renewal (end-June) — confirm renewed & at higher prices.
Preform stabilization & cost benefit (end-Q2/Q3); germanium supply.
Comm EBIT margin trajectory toward 8-9% target.
Solar line doubling progress; export ramp (target 2-3% share).
FMEG/fans turnaround signs.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
